image_description: A large, dark brown bison standing in a grassy field with scattered white wildflowers and small evergreen trees in the background. The bison is facing slightly left, showing its massive shoulder hump, shaggy forequarters, and curved horns. The hindquarters appear smoother and less furred. The legs are partially obscured by tall grass.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, broad, and features two short, curved horns consistent with bison anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct beard of long, dark hair is visible hanging from the chin and throat area.
The visible eye is dark and positioned correctly on the side of the head.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and blended into the thick fur of the head, which is characteristic.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits a massive build with a high shoulder hump, typical of bison proportions.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, shaggy dark brown fur, creating a very prominent shoulder hump.
The rear section of the body has visibly shorter, smoother hair compared to the front, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are relatively short and curved, proportional to the massive size of the head and body.
The lower legs and hooves are completely occluded by the tall grass and wildflowers in the foreground. Cannot verify cloven hooves.
The tail is not visible in this angle/pose; it is either hidden behind the hindquarters or out of frame.
